description: A tabletop is covered with many tiny colorful beads, with a small white dustpan resting on the left and a small hand brush on the right. The left hand stays near the left side without touching any object, while the right hand holds the right-hand object (the brush) and sweeps it from the right edge inward and slightly left, pushing scattered beads into a tighter pile near the back wall, then lifting and repositioning the brush to continue sweeping.
